title: Dawnstead - Warm Shadows, Open Sky
_note: Mood sibling, bittersweet. gbc 4-voice, no chords. 96 BPM, 4/4, C major, tender-radiant. The Tinderwick lullaby reprised in major - but gentler and more intimate than A: joy with a tear in it, the memory of the long night still warm in the major. Vesper FULL BLOOM in major, but stated tenderly (exhaled) not triumphantly. Harmony = soft flowing arpeggio, less sparkle more glow. Bass = warm rocking hearth pulse (closer to Tinderwick A's), not a busy stride. Percussion = very light, a soft heartbeat brush. 16-bar loop (the lullaby's own length) ~40s.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Lullaby in major, tender/intimate. Vesper bloom exhaled: G3->C4->D4 lift ... E4->D4->C4 settle, lower register than A, more rests, more breath. Former B section glows but stays gentle. Final bar leans on G (V) into bar 1.
